maddeler.e:
استقذرا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْذَرَا (istaqḏarā) /is.taq.ða.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# اُسْتُقْذِرَا (ustuqḏirā) /us.tuq.ði.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# اِسْتَقْذِرَا (istaqḏirā) /is.taq.ði.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
